common: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: AQUABIT game two-frame pixel sprite strip. Image 1 is the user's PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE: a VERY CHUNKY, primitive cute blue shrimp with thick single dark navy stepped outline, big flat blue/cyan rectangles, NO intricate scales or detailing. Image 2 is an existing species sprite to REPLACE; preserve recognizable species only, NOT its over-detailed thin style. Create a transparent PNG horizontal strip of TWO equal cells, no gap between cells, no labels, no border. Virtual sheet is EXACTLY 96x32 pixels: each cell 48x32. Each cell has 4px empty margin. Draw on a COARSE 24x16 conceptual grid per cell, each conceptual pixel a perfectly aligned square 2x2 block; no finer details. Thick navy #0b1d3a outline, max 6 opaque flat colors, blocky stepped silhouette, 1 simple eye, cheerful understated retro game look. Both creatures face LEFT, same position/size/palette, left cell rest frame, right cell subtle fin/leg movement only. Do NOT flip the second frame. No growth, no decorations, no shading gradients, no texture, no scales, no thin diagonals, no antialiasing, no text, no background, no shadow or glow. Fill most of each cell but do not touch cell edges. Export with real transparent alpha. Large image output must be an EXACT integer nearest-neighbor enlargement of this coarse virtual pixel strip, aspect ratio 3:1.

species.shrimp: Blue velvet shrimp: closely match Image 1's silhouette, low left-facing blue body, raised rounded back on right, tiny black eye at left, short antennae sweeping upper-left, 4 chunky short leg pairs below, compact tail fan on right. Blue #1569bc and cyan #3ccce0, small white highlight. Keep it VERY SIMPLE and cute, NOT a realistic crustacean. Frame 2 alternates short legs.
species.gold: Goldfish: oval short orange body, simple chunky forked or fan tail on right, small raised dorsal fin, small pectoral fin, tiny dark eye left. Orange #ff9d36, shade #e77323, pale cream highlight. Match reference's simplicity with only 3 large body color patches, NO scales/dots. Frame 2 flicks tail one coarse pixel.
species.angel: Angelfish: tall compact cyan diamond body, triangular dorsal and ventral fins, small tail on right, one or two short chunky trailing ventral fin tips, dark eye left. Cyan #36bcd8, blue #167da8, pale cyan #b9f6f2. Match chunky shrimp style with wide blocks and thick outline, no speckled markings. Frame 2 tips fins slightly.
species.betta: Betta: compact purple body, large simple billowing fan tail on right, single broad bottom fin and upper fin, clearly different from angelfish. Lavender #a290ec, deeper purple #675ec0, pale lilac #e2d8ff. 3 big flat patches only, no filigree or scales. Frame 2 gently folds tail tip.
species.guppy: Guppy: small teal body left, distinctive large coral-red triangular fan tail right, simple dorsal fin and black eye, NOT goldfish. Teal #50d5b1, darker teal #279f98, tail coral #fa7b78, pale mint #c3ffdf. No tail dots or patterns. Same coarse outline and chunky blocks as shrimp. Frame 2 tail tip flick.
species.neon: Neon tetra: small slim left-facing fish, deep navy contour and back, a wide cyan horizontal stripe and red stripe on lower right body, petite right tail. Cyan #38d8e3, cobalt #207abd, red #f06c70, white #e0fff9. Tiny simple fins. Retain identifiable neon stripe but do not add details. Same chunky navy outlined style as shrimp. Frame 2 tail flick.
